name: M5.PolynomialIndicator.residual_factors_regular
statement: ∀ (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (N : ℕ), 0 < N → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → ∀ p ∈ M5.PolynomialExclusion.residualFactors (M5.cyclicModulus N) F, p.Monic ∧ Irreducible p
guidance: Use accepted M5.PolynomialExclusion.cyclic_quotient_nonzero and normalizedFactors membership irreducibility; M5.Signature.binary_monic makes every nonzero binary polynomial monic. Fully qualify imported theorem names. Return tactic lines without leading by; do not change target.
